title: Set up the estimate
text: Every derivative of sin(x) is plus or minus sin(x) or cos(x), so $$M=1$$. Since $$|x|$$ can be as large as the endpoints of the interval, we need $${\pi}^{n+1}$$ divided by the factorial of $$n+1$$ to be at most $$\frac{1}{1000}$$.

title: Test values of $$n$$
text: For $$n=11$$ the bound is about $$0.0019$$, which is too big, and for $$n=12$$ it is about $$0.00047$$. So the smallest $$n$$ is $$12$$.
